scope.coverage: ONLY the two additive FranklinWH routes below and the new shared /privacy page. This spec does not describe or cover the original root page.

notCovered.status: Protected legacy campaign page, unchanged and not rebuilt by this task. Its page, layout and globals.css were moved byte-identically to src/app/(legacy)/; every other protected file is untouched. Its own form, phone and tracking are outside this spec.

scope.focus: FranklinWH home battery backup (aGate, aPower S, aPower 2, aPower X) designed and installed by Peninsula Solar as a modern alternative to a standby generator, for grid-connected Northern Michigan homes that lose power and off-grid cabins and camps.
scope.pageDifferences: The routes share one page component and differ only in phone number and office mention.

site.registration: Existing call.peninsula-solar.com registration reused; no new site registered.

tracking.gtmLoader: MegaTag (MEGA_TAG_CONFIG in src/app/(franklinwh)/layout.tsx); no manual GTM tag
tracking.callTracking: Universal CTM https://572388.tctm.co/t.js, body, afterInteractive. CTM numbers, receiving numbers and DNI are Instrumentation-owned, not configured here.

/privacy.note: Shared by both routes, so it shows no phone.

phoneRule: Every authored number and tel: link on a route is that route's own number only, including alerts, success state and footer.

form.submit: type="button", validate first, direct send; no type="submit" and no requestSubmit(). Enter is stopped at keydown; onSubmit is only a backstop.

responseSemantics.accepted: HTTP 2xx AND parsed body ok === true. Then exactly one MegaTag.trackEvent('form_submit', { elementId, formData }) and one dataLayer form_submission. The page-view lock stays held.
responseSemantics.rejected: Non-2xx, or a body with ok === false. Retry-capable alert with the route phone; draft kept; lock released.
responseSemantics.unknown: Fetch rejected, response lost, invalid JSON, null body, or a 2xx without an explicit ok. Delivery could not be confirmed: draft kept, both forms disabled for this page view, alert offers the route phone and does not invite a resend. No success, no conversion events.
responseSemantics.invalid: Fails validation before any request; nothing is sent and the fields stay fixable.

cta.primaryBelow640: Free quote (section-pair anchors only; the form submit always reads Request a free quote)
cta.secondary: Call <route phone> (number only below 640px, phone icon kept)

brand.colorSource: FranklinWH Visual Identity (pp. 11, 16) via marketing.franklinwh.com; black text on the orange fill
brand.typeface: Inter (FranklinWH corporate typeface, Visual Identity p. 16), loaded with next/font/google

privacy: No customer policy existed (/privacy-policy returned 404), so a business-specific policy was written at /privacy listing exactly the six form fields; no SMS section.

ccp.creative.doNotUse: Google call forwarding numbers replacing on-site phone numbers: the page source authors only the two real route numbers.
ccp.compliance.implications: No savings, tax-credit, financing or ROI claims anywhere on the routes.
